brand_identity.name: Artisan & Aura
brand_identity.description: A sanctuary for handmade, artisanal interior decor.

usage_rules.primary_usage: Only for high-priority CTAs (Buy Now, Checkout)
usage_rules.text_contrast: Ensure WCAG AA compliance. Use #1C1917 for main text, #57534E for secondary.

grid_system.product_list: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-x-8 gap-y-16

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-stone-800 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-stone-300 text-stone-800 hover:border-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-50 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.product: group relative flex flex-col gap-4 bg-transparent border-none shadow-none
cards.feature: bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-stone-100 p-8 rounded-2xl hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-500

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-stone-300 rounded-none px-0 py-4 focus:ring-0 focus:border-stone-800 placeholder:text-stone-400 text-stone-800 transition-colors

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-100/50
navigation.link: text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 transition-colors

textures.grain: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Run `npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge` first.
THEME SETUP: Modify `tailwind.config.js` to use the colors defined in `brand_identity.colors`. DO NOT use default shadcn slate colors.
FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to `index.css` immediately.
LAYOUT: Use the `spacing_and_layout` rules. Do not create cramped layouts. Always use `py-20` or `py-32` for section vertical spacing.
COMPONENTS: Customize shadcn components. Remove sharp corners (use `rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`). Remove heavy borders (use subtle `border-stone-200`).
INTERACTIONS: All buttons and cards MUST have hover states defined in `visual_enhancers`. Use `framer-motion` for page entrance animations.
IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for the MVP. Do not leave image src empty.
NAVIGATION: Create a sticky header with a blur effect (`backdrop-blur-md`). Center the logo (Serif font).
FOOTER: Create a large, multi-column footer with the brand mission statement.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
